Standard built-in player only; applies when playback starts. On Android 9+, compress loud peaks when the device supports the effect. Older Android uses a small equalizer adjustment. Does not isolate dialogue; passthrough and external players may bypass it.
Allow supported Live TV streams to play without server conversion. Turn off if channels fail to play reliably.
Let the TV match the video frame rate for smoother motion. Mode changes may briefly blank the screen; support depends on the device and display.
Choose how video fits the screen by default. Filling the screen can crop the picture or change its proportions.
Choose how audio is sent to your TV or receiver. Direct output requires compatible equipment; downmixing converts multichannel audio for fewer speakers.
Choose how far ahead the player loads video. Larger buffers use more memory and may help with brief network interruptions.
Restore subtitle brightness to 100%. Other subtitle appearance settings stay as they are.
